claims.text: A few thousand commits of building this way.
Merges go through a script that pins the exact commit being merged and refuses if any check is pending or failing.
It has refused me twice when a branch moved under me.
Pre-commit gates block a model name typed by hand.
Pre-commit gates block a file moved while something still points to the old path.
Pre-commit gates block a page whose text wraps badly at some screen width.
Every merge ends with a decision receipt, and the ledger refuses edits; a correction is a new row.
Whether the receipts make the calls better over time is not yet known; scoring stays off until enough outcomes close.
